name: robots/lihuang3__ur5_ros-gazebo
title: UR5 vacuum gripper array (Gazebo)
intro: UR5 vacuum gripper array (Gazebo), adapted from lihuang3/ur5_ros-gazebo. It reads `read_grasping`, `read_tracker` and `read_block_poses`; runs `vacuum_gripper_0_on`, `vacuum_gripper_1_on`, `vacuum_gripper_2_on`, `vacuum_gripper_3_on` and 14 more. `vacuum_gripper_0_on`: call the acknowledged /ur5/vacuum_gripper/on std_srvs/Empty service; the empty reply confirms only that the plugin handler returned. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
